name: Deshi Shahi Cow
description: Healthy, vigorous Deshi Shahi cow nurtured on lush natural grass and organic grains in Bogura pasture. Pure pedigree, gentle temperament, fully vaccinated, and compliant with all religious physical requirements for Qurbani.

name: Red Chittagong Cow
description: Indigenous Red Chittagong breed renowned for solid muscle build, rich coat, and superior meat quality. Raised with special veterinary supervision, crystal clear eyes, and flawless teeth condition ready for sacred sacrifice.

name: Black Bengal Goat
description: Purebred Black Bengal he-goat famous for unmatched taste and tenderness. Extremely active, well-developed horns, glossy black coat, properly aged past 14 months, and fed nutritious green legumes.

name: Sahiwal Prime Cow
description: Magnificent reddish-brown Sahiwal bull with a prominent hump and strong bone structure. Reared on dairy farm silage and mineral licks. High meat ratio, calm handling, and verified health certificate included.

name: Jamunapari Royal Goat
description: Tall, majestic Jamunapari buck with distinctive convex face profile and long pendulous ears. Impeccably groomed, strong legs, pristine coat, and fed rich clover hay. Perfect choice for auspicious Eid offering.

name: Brahman Master Bull
description: Colossal Brahman bull with silvery-grey coat, muscular stature, and supreme health. Farm-raised in Savar under expert care. Ideal for shared family sacrifice (7 shares) with guaranteed high yield.

name: Munshiganj Deshi Cow
description: Naturally pastured Munshiganj grass-fed cow. Modest size, highly affordable, perfect health condition with symmetrical horns, completely free from artificial fattening chemicals.

name: Beetal White Buck
description: Impressive white and brown patched Beetal goat from northern farms. Large frame, heavy weight, lively and energetic, verified two teeth age requirement fully fulfilled.
